doc.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Tape change; Joey Baron, Fred Hersch and Marc Johnson in his group
summary: He recalls playing Blue in Green with his quartet.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: Okay, we’re going to have to change a tape.
He played, but we played together and that was my group—Joey Baron
And Marc Johnson. And I asked him in the middle of a set, “Joey, [want to?] play on the solo?” He said, “Blue and green.” [laughs] The slow number.

[imitates] [laughs] And we… he was in Brussels… in Antwerp, right, with John Zorn. And I asked him… we crossed… “Mr. Play blue and green.” [laughs] And these guys, you know… Joey and Greg Cohen, the bass player… they’re [bad guys?].
